name: Rare Hidden Cache never drops statless Bloodforged Replica T0.5 items (#11917, #13463)
contract: Requires Bloodforged.Enable = 1 with rev_20261126_11917_bloodforged_remove_replica_t05.sql applied. The 32 Bloodforged Replica T0.5 cosmetic items (6078196-6078330, item level 60, required level 60) carry no primary or secondary stats and are removed from coa_bloodforged_catalogue. A Rare Hidden Cache (gameobject loot 9671) always picks one normal level-60 epic from the catalogue: reported items Bloodforged Replica Darkmantle Boots (6078262, #11917) and Bloodforged Replica Soulforge Gauntlets (6078314, #13463), plus representative cloth/mail entries (6078196, 6078282), never drop (0% across 10,000 rolls), while Bloodforged Writ of the Emperor (6098000, item level 61, RandomProperty 8676) continues to drop.
